tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250yak+sha dzam bha la ljang gu'i gtor 'bul 'dod rgu'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// 1$0000300oṃ swasti sid+dhi/

byang gter thugs sgrub las byung ba'i dzaṃ lha ljang gu'i gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshul ni/ snga dro'am dgong mo'i char rin po che'i snod gtsang mar 'bras zan dang dkar gsum mngar gsum gyi gtor ma rgya chen po bshams la chab kyis bran/ swa bhā wa sa sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las trāṃ las rin po che'i snod du a las gtor ma lha'i zhal zas ro mchog brgya dang ldan par gyur/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: oṃ āḥhūm̐: zhes pas brlab/ phyag na rdo rje'i bdag bskyed rgyas par bsgom pa'am bsdu na/ rang skad cig gis dpal phyag na rdo rje sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan cing pad nyi'i gdan la zhabs dor stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ de'i thugs ka'i sa bon las mdun du paṃ gyi yi ge mched pas pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can steng gi phyogs su 'phros pas/ lha dbang brgya byin khang bzang gi byang phyogs gnod sbyin rol pa'i gzhal yas nas nor gyi bdag po yak+sha dzam bha la spyan drangs par gyur/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ mdun du pad zla'i gdan steng du// dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa ni// gnod sbyin chen po dzam bha la: sku mdog ljang gu in+d+ra'i mdog: phyag g.yas rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin: g.yon pa ne'u le nor skyug bsnams: rgyal po rol pa'i gar stabs kyis: 'gro la thugs rjes bzhengs nas bzhugs: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan: sku las 'od zer bye ba 'phro: gzi brjid mdangs dang ldan par gsal: zhes brjod cing gsal gdab/ mdun gyi lha'i zhal nas ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyi 'od zer gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bas mnyes par bsam la/ oṃ dzam bha la dza len+d+ra ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta grih+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi swā hā:

lan bdun gyis phul/ oṃ yak+sha dzam bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tits+tsha swā hā 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūm̐: phrin las rig mchog dpal dang ldan: sku mdog ljang khu 'od zer 'phro: rin chen sna tshogs rgyan gyis brgyan: don yod grub pa dbu la bzhugs: zhi ma khro ba'i cha lugs can: phyag g.yas rin chen rgyal mtshan bsnams: g.yon pa ne'u le nor skyug 'dzin: 'gying ba'i tshul 'chang gsus khyim che: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum brjid pa'i tshul: pad+ma zla ba'i gdan steng du: gnod sbyin nor bdag pho mo gnyis: brjid pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs: nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa: srid pa gsum gyi bcud len zhing: 'bru bcud sdud pa'i bdag nyid can: khyod la bstod cing mchod pa la: phrin las grub pa'i dngos grub sbyin: yak+sha gnod sbyin dzam bha la: phrin las sgrub la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces pas bstod/ gnod sbyin dbang po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pas phrin las gsol/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mdun gyi ye shes pa rang la thim pas rang nyid mthu stobs nus pa gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*// bsod nams ye shes las byung ba'i// dam pa sku gnyis thob par shog / ces bsngo smon dang*/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa// yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam bzhin// sems can re ba skong mdzad pa// bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog / ces sogs bkra shis ji ltar rigs pa brjod/ gtor ma las cung zad dngos grub kyi tshul du rol zhing*/ lhag ma mdzod kyi phugs sogs su bzhag pas longs spyod dbyar gyi chu gter ltar rgyas par 'gyur ro// zhes byang gter gzhung rtsa ba'i dgongs don ji lta bar mtsho skyes bla ma dgyes pa'i 'bangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge legs 'phel// maṅga laṃ/// /
